decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The colour and material of the playground surface shall match the colour and properties of the samples submitted with the application, being sample Nos. 2, 5 and 6 that have the following composition:2) 50% beige, 50% red5) 50% beige, 50% red, 25% eggshell, 25% brown6) 25% green, 25% beige, 25% brown, 25% eggshell

Condition : 4 - The resurfacing the playground of existing school with soft proprietary materials, as shown on drawing number 657/01, received 28 February 2006, would not harm the setting of the Listed Building on the site. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, and ENV-B.2.5 Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building.
description: Resurfacing the playground of existing school with soft proprietory materials
